task.description: Sahifani jonlantiring. 1) #like-btn ga bosish #like-count dagi sonni 1 ga oshiradi. 2) #theme-toggle ga bosish body dagi theme-dark klassini almashtiradi va tugmaga aria-pressed ni "true" yoki "false" qilib qo‘yadi. 3) #faq ga bitta ishlov beruvchi (delegatsiya): .faq__question ga bosish o‘z .faq__item idagi .faq__answer ni ko‘rsatadi yoki yashiradi va aria-expanded ni yangilaydi. 4) Sahifada Escape barcha javoblarni yopadi va aria-expanded="false" qo‘yadi. 5) #comment ga kiritishda #comment-counter ga "12 / 100" yoziladi. Faqat addEventListener; onclick, innerHTML va element.style ishlatmang.

tests.name: «Yoqdi» ga bir bosish → 1
tests.fail: Ishlov beruvchida likes ni oshiring va #like-count ga yozing: likeCount.textContent = String(likes);

tests.name: Uch bosish → 3
tests.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector("#like-btn"); b.click(); b.click(); b.click(); return document.querySelector("#like-count").textContent === "3"; })()
tests.fail: let likes = 0; ni ishlov beruvchidan TASHQARIDA e’lon qiling, aks holda hisob har safar qaytadan boshlanadi.

tests.name: Mavzu: bir bosish theme-dark va aria-pressed="true" ni yoqadi
tests.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector("#theme-toggle"); b.click(); return document.body.classList.contains("theme-dark") && b.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true"; })()

tests.name: Mavzu: ikkinchi bosish o‘chiradi
tests.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector("#theme-toggle"); b.click(); b.click(); return !document.body.classList.contains("theme-dark") && b.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "false"; })()

tests.name: Savolga bosish javobni ochadi va aria-expanded="true" qo‘yadi
Takroriy bosish javobni yopadi
tests.fail: Almashtiring: answer.hidden = !answer.hidden va yangi holat bo‘yicha aria-expanded.

tests.name: Tugma ichidagi span ga bosish ham ishlaydi
tests.fail: event.target ichki element bo‘lishi mumkin - event.target.closest(".faq__question") dan foydalaning.

tests.name: Yuklangandan keyin qo‘shilgan savol ishlaydi (delegatsiya)
tests.check: (() => { const item = document.createElement("div"); item.className = "faq__item"; const q = document.createElement("button"); q.type = "button"; q.className = "faq__question"; q.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false"); q.textContent = "Yangi?"; const a = document.createElement("p"); a.className = "faq__answer"; a.hidden = true; a.textContent = "Ha"; item.append(q, a); document.querySelector("#faq").append(item); q.click(); return a.hidden === false && q.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true"; })()
tests.fail: Har bir tugmaga emas, #faq ga BITTA ishlov beruvchi qo‘ying: shunda yangi savollar ham ishlaydi.

tests.name: «Savollar» sarlavhasiga bosish hech narsani buzmaydi
tests.fail: Bosish savolga bo‘lmasa, closest null qaytaradi - ishlov beruvchidan chiqing: if (!question) { return; }

tests.name: Escape barcha javoblarni yopadi
tests.check: (() => { document.querySelectorAll(".faq__question")[0].click(); document.querySelectorAll(".faq__question")[1].click(); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", bubbles: true })); return [...document.querySelectorAll(".faq__answer")].every((a) => a.hidden) && [...document.querySelectorAll(".faq__question")].every((q) => q.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "false"); })()

tests.name: Boshqa tugmalar javoblarni yopmaydi
tests.check: (() => { document.querySelectorAll(".faq__question")[0].click(); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Enter", bubbles: true })); return document.querySelectorAll(".faq__answer")[0].hidden === false; })()

tests.name: Belgilar hisoblagichi: «JavaScript» → "10 / 100"
tests.check: (() => { const c = document.querySelector("#comment"); c.value = "JavaScript"; c.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); return document.querySelector("#comment-counter").textContent === "10 / 100"; })()

hints: Layklar hisoblagichi: let likes = 0; ishlov beruvchidan tashqarida.
Klass qo‘shilgan bo‘lsa, classList.toggle true qaytaradi: const isDark = document.body.classList.toggle("theme-dark");
Delegatsiya: faq.addEventListener("click", (event) => { const question = event.target.closest(".faq__question"); if (!question) { return; } ... });

wrong_solutions.mistake: hisoblagich ishlov beruvchi ichida e’lon qilingan
delegatsiya o‘rniga har bir tugmada ishlov beruvchi

questions.question: Qaysi yozuv btn tugmasini bosishga to‘g‘ri obuna qiladi?
questions.explanation: Funksiya qavssiz beriladi; hodisa turi - satr.

questions.question: Ishlov beruvchi ichida let likes = 0; bo‘lsa, nima uchun sahifada doim 1 turadi?
options: O‘zgaruvchi har bosishda nol bilan qaytadan yaratiladi

questions.question: Hodisa obyektining qaysi xususiyati hodisa sodir bo‘lgan elementni saqlaydi? event.<xususiyat> ko‘rinishida kiriting.
Hodisani payt bilan moslashtiring.
questions.explanation: Hodisa turi - addEventListener ning birinchi argumenti.

questions.question: Escape tugmasi bosilganini qanday tekshirish mumkin?
Havolaga bosish ishlov beruvchisidagi event.preventDefault() nima qiladi?
Hodisalar ko‘tarilishi nima?
questions.explanation: Shuning uchun tugmaga bosishni uning konteynerida ushlash mumkin.

questions.question: Nima uchun delegatsiyada shunchaki event.target emas, event.target.closest(".item")?
options: Bosish ichki elementdan (span, belgi) kelishi mumkin, closest .item ning o‘zini topadi
questions.explanation: closest elementning o‘zidan boshlab ota-onalar bo‘ylab yuqoriga qidiradi.

questions.question: Qaysi yechimlar ochiladigan blokni qulay qiladi?
questions.explanation: div fokus olmaydi va klaviaturadan bosilmaydi.

questions.question: String(true) qanday qiymat beradi? Uni kiriting.
questions.explanation: aria-atributlar - satrlar, shuning uchun qiymatlar String() orqali aylantiriladi.

questions.question: Nima uchun kursda onclick="..." atributi ishlatilmaydi?
options: U kodni belgilash bilan aralashtiradi; ishlov beruvchilar JS faylda yashaydi
questions.explanation: CSS dagi style="" kabi: HTML va xatti-harakatni ajratamiz.
